remarks:
**Privacy, acreage, craftsmanship, and convenience — all in one exceptional property!** Tucked away at the end of a quiet dead-end street, 7493 Crestwood Circle offers 8.8 picturesque acres in the Town of Boston, combining the benefits of Boston taxes with the highly sought-after Orchard Park School District. An outdoor enthusiast's dream, this incredible setting offers room to roam, explore, and enjoy the outdoors, all while being minutes from the conveniences of Orchard Park and Boston and just a stone's throw from Chestnut Ridge Park.

Step inside to discover a home filled with warmth and character, showcasing exceptional custom woodworking and hardwood craftsmanship throughout. The beautifully updated kitchen (2024) features quartz countertops, while a convenient first-floor primary bedroom and first-floor laundry with abundant storage add everyday practicality.

Beyond its charm, the property boasts substantial improvements, including a newer 2.5-car garage (2023), new vinyl siding (2022), updated windows, tankless hot water heater (2022), upgraded electrical service (2023), and extensive concrete work. A basement drainage system and exterior drainage improvements with a transferable warranty provide additional peace of mind. Other updates include: Young roof, all new doors, insulation, and several electrical upgrades. 

**With nearly 9 acres, remarkable character, and extensive improvements, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of country living without sacrificing convenience!** An offer deadline has been set for Tuesday, October 20th at noon.
